title: Candidate Relationship Resolution
objective: Allow Flora to resolve and inspect governed relationships between imported candidate Twin objects before promotion without changing their candidate governance state.
implementation_summary: Candidate Relationship objects resolve through exact endpoint identities inside their own import-run Semantic Twin read context.
Resolution diagnostics distinguish candidate-resolved, candidate-unresolved and promoted relationships with explicit reason categories.
Functional acceptance readiness is independent of optional deployment telemetry completeness.
expected_visible_outcomes: Advanced Inspection visibly distinguishes candidate-resolved relationships, promoted relationships and unresolved reasons.
BT Group and every Enterprise dossier use the shared relationship resolver and show only explicit typed associations.
Opportunities remains exactly 17 and Major Programmes remains exactly 13.
Missing factual dimensions remain missing and no candidate is reviewed, assessed or promoted automatically.
unchanged_areas: Importer, validator, adapter, semantic construction, Canonical Factual Projection semantics, Observation runtime, owner assessment, Research Gaps logic, executive page semantics, TEL-001 fixture, governance and promotion remain unchanged by this operational acceptance panel.
TEL-001 package contents and checksum remain unchanged.
No automatic acceptance, promotion, recommendations or TEL-001-specific production logic is introduced.
required_test_steps: Open BT Group and inspect Programme and Opportunity IDs and governed relationship labels.
Check all six Enterprise dossiers for exact relationship-derived association sets and isolated factual dimensions.
Open Advanced Inspection and inspect all three reconciliation tables.
Count 17 rendered Opportunity containers and 13 rendered Programme containers.
fresh_import_policy: Fresh import is required only when the approved change is live and material runtime components that affect candidate representation changed before the candidate was imported. UI-only, presentation-only and diagnostics-only panel changes do not require reimport. If timestamps or component classification are unavailable, Flora reports Cannot determine rather than forcing a reimport.

automated_validation.known_failing_tests: None in focused population/relationship acceptance suite.

operator_validation_status: PASS — real TEL-001 routes rendered to repository acceptance artefacts
merge_mode: unverified until GitHub merge metadata or deployed change marker is available
fresh_import_required: No — resolution is a read-only query over candidate state already staged within the import run.
